selection: One candidate minimizing equal-flow full-validation mean for pnn_trans at n=1024. All nine selected PNN and matched Raw validation RMSE/r must be below 3 before final-stage submission. Raw uses the identical candidate, architecture after input projection, and optimization budget. If the gate fails, report all validation results and do not open test.
evaluation: Frozen seven-line 32-step 3.1/4.1 data. Position RMSE/r over 7x31 noninitial points. Test is a previously used benchmark, not new confirmation. Failed final models remain in reports and receive no test evaluation. Compare frozen 4.1/5.1 historical baselines separately, never replace them.
checkpoints: No model files. Best state RAM only; retain predictions and scalar records.
